highlights: Air Quality Management with real-time data and HEPA air purifiers in all classrooms and common rooms
Rigorous daily and weekly cleaning schedules with SteriPlant sanitising water spray
Monthly deep cleaning process using UVC light sterilisation
Dedicated culinary team with a nutritionist-led chef and strict no processed foods policy
safety.policy_summary: Li'lberry takes health, wellbeing, and safety very seriously by implementing daily air quality monitoring, HEPA air purifiers in all rooms, rigorous sanitisation and UVC sterilisation protocols, and strict nutrition standards without processed foods.
